name: Phrasal Verbs
description: Common two-word and three-word phrasal verbs, separable and inseparable patterns, and phrasal verbs in everyday and exam contexts.

passages.title: A Messy Room
passages.content:
My mum told me to (1) ______ my room before dinner. I (2) ______ all the clothes from the floor and put them in the wardrobe. Then I (3) ______ the old magazines, because I did not need them any more.

When Mum came in, she could not (4) ______ how I had done it so fast. She said I could (5) ______ with my friends after dinner as a reward.

passages.title: Learning to Skate
passages.content:
When I first tried ice skating, I kept (1) ______ over every few metres. My friend told me not to (2) ______ up and showed me how to keep my balance.

After an hour I finally (3) ______ on. We have (4) ______ up a plan to go to the rink every Sunday, and I am really looking (5) ______ to next week.

passages.title: The Broken Laptop
passages.content:
Two days before my project was due, my laptop suddenly (1) ______ down. I had not (2) ______ up my files for weeks, so I was in a panic.

My uncle, who works in IT, offered to help me (3) ______ what had gone wrong. It (4) ______ out that only the battery was dead, and all my work was safe. From now on, I will (5) ______ up everything every day.

passages.title: Starting a Book Club
passages.content:
When our local library threatened to close its reading room, a group of teenagers decided to (1) ______ up a book club to keep it busy. At first only five people (2) ______ up to the meetings.

But the idea soon (3) ______ on, and by the spring there were thirty members. The director was so impressed that she (4) ______ out of closing the room. The club has now (5) ______ up with a local café that gives members free hot chocolate.

questions.title: I need to ___ this word in a dictionary.
questions.explanation: «Look up» означає шукати в словнику чи довіднику.

questions.title: Could you ___ the television? I am trying to read.
She had to ___ her grandmother while her parents were away.
We have ___ of milk. I will buy some on the way home.
questions.explanation: «Run out of» означає, що запас вичерпався.

questions.title: The plane ___ twenty minutes late.
Please ___ your shoes before entering.
I ___ an old friend at the station yesterday.
He ___ smoking three years ago.
What time do you usually ___ in the morning?
The meeting was ___ until next Tuesday.
Which phrasal verb means 'to enter a bus or train'?
questions.explanation: «Get on» уживають щодо посадки в транспорт.

questions.title: I cannot ___ with all this noise.
questions.explanation: «Put up with» означає терпіти щось неприємне.

questions.title: She ___ the lights before leaving the flat.
questions.explanation: «Switch off» означає вимкнути світло чи прилад.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Значення фразового дієслова не випливає зі значень його частин.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the sentence it completes.
pairs: I get up at seven every day.
We get on well with our neighbours.
It took her a month to get over the flu.
They get by on a small income.

questions.title: Match each verb with the particle that gives the stated meaning.
questions.explanation: Частка після «break» щоразу дає нове значення.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with its one-word synonym.
questions.explanation: Фразові дієслова мають однослівні формальні відповідники.

questions.title: Match each situation with the phrasal verb that fits it.
questions.explanation: «Take» з різними частками охоплює зовсім різні ситуації.

questions.title: The negotiations eventually ___ because neither side would compromise.
I came ___ this photograph while I was tidying the attic.
The police are looking ___ the disappearance of the documents.
We will have to ___ the meeting because two people are ill.
He ___ an excuse on the spot, and nobody believed it.
She ___ the offer because the salary was too low.
Nobody ___ that the figures had been altered.
questions.explanation: «Pick up on» означає помітити те, що інші проґавили.

questions.title: The company is trying to ___ the losses of last year.
We are ___ new staff for the summer season.
He ___ his father in both looks and temperament.
questions.explanation: «Take after» означає бути схожим на родича.

questions.title: The rumour ___ that the factory would close.
I could not ___ what the sign said from that distance.
Match each three-word phrasal verb with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Трислівні фразові дієслова нероздільні й мають цілісне значення.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the formal verb closest in meaning.
questions.explanation: У формальному письмі фразові дієслова часто замінюють однослівними.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the sentence that shows its meaning.
pairs: The rumour turned out to be false.
She turned up an hour late.
questions.explanation: Частка після «turn» щоразу дає інше значення.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the meaning the particle adds.
questions.explanation: Частка й додаток разом визначають значення дієслова «run».

questions.title: Match each separable phrasal verb with a correct sentence.
pairs: Fill it in and return it.
questions.explanation: Займенник у роздільного фразового дієслова стоїть обов'язково всередині.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the field where it is common.
questions.explanation: Багато фразових дієслів закріпилися за конкретними сферами вжитку.

questions.title: The scheme was ___ after only eighteen months.
The chairman ___ the objections raised by the minority.
The auditors ___ several irregularities in the accounts.
questions.explanation: «Turn up» тут означає «виявити» під час перевірки.

questions.title: Negotiations were ___ by the sudden resignation of the mediator.
questions.explanation: «Throw off course» означає збити з наміченого шляху.

questions.title: Match each formal phrasal verb with its academic equivalent.
questions.explanation: Академічні тексти мають власний набір фразових дієслів із точними відповідниками.

questions.title: Match each business phrasal verb with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Ділова англійська має свій набір фразових дієслів.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the register it belongs to.
questions.explanation: Фразові дієслова різняться регістром — від академічного до розмовного.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the nuance that distinguishes it from its neighbours.
questions.explanation: Частка після «get» тонко змінює значення всього вислову.

questions.title: Match each phrasal verb with the noun form derived from it.
questions.explanation: Від фразових дієслів утворюються іменники злитим написанням: break through → breakthrough, set back → setback, turn out → turnout.
